related.title: QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較；QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機改以可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison; QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine centers on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照QUBO與Ising符號與Aquila光鑷佔位，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以完整服務時間為起點，設計一項能區分「QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較」與「可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare qubo and ising signs with aquila tweezer occupancy and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from full service elapsed time and propose an observation distinguishing qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison from reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation, including uncertainty.

practiceEn: Compare qubo and ising signs with transmon levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from full service elapsed time and propose an observation distinguishing qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison from tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, including uncertainty.
